stories.title: Xi Jinping arrives in Washington for three-day talks with Trump
stories.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping is making a three-day state visit to Washington starting Sept. 23 for high-stakes talks with Donald Trump. Trade, tariffs, rare earths, AI safety, Taiwan, Iran and fentanyl are topping the agenda.

stories.title: US and Iran hold mediated UNGA talks on ending war and reopening Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: US and Iranian delegations held hours of mediator-shuttled talks on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, with special envoy Steve Witkoff confirming a completed round of discussions. Tehran tied diplomatic progress to lifting shipping blockades and unfreezing frozen assets.

stories.title: Iran offers to reopen Strait of Hormuz within a week if US lifts blockade
stories.summary: A senior Iranian official said Tehran could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days if Washington eases military pressure and lifts its naval blockade of Iranian ports. The waterway carried roughly a fifth of global oil and gas shipments before the war.

stories.title: Anthropic and OpenAI launch cheaper models despite calls to slow AI development
stories.summary: Anthropic debuted Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and Luna, both emphasizing lower-cost, high-performance tiers — Opus 5.5 and Sol/Luna carry 50% API price cuts vs their predecessors. The launches come just days after both labs' CEOs urged a slowdown in frontier development.

stories.title: Palma.ai raises $1.8M to bring governed AI agents to more enterprises
stories.summary: Palma.ai, an enterprise platform that governs AI agents at runtime by controlling permissions, policies and audit trails, closed a $1.8 million pre-seed round led by D11Z. It will use the funding to expand go-to-market and engineering teams.

stories.title: Nokia releases AnyJev to remove LLM bias without retraining
stories.summary: Nokia's applied research team published AnyJev, an Apache-2.0 Python library that turns an existing open LLM into a calibrated decision model without fine-tuning or labeled data. It targets prior and position bias that quietly degrade accuracy in production classification jobs.

stories.title: C2C lets AI models communicate through KV caches instead of text
stories.summary: Tsinghua researchers presented C2C, a method for inter-model communication using internal KV caches rather than text tokens, showing 9.6–11.9 point accuracy gains and up to 14x lower latency in benchmarks. It requires access to model internals, so it fits those running their own inference stacks.

stories.title: Illinois vs Ohio State: predictions and scouting ahead of Big Ten opener
stories.summary: An inside look at the Illinois vs Ohio State game — Ohio State's first Big Ten contest of 2026 — with predictions, betting odds, and scouting reports. No. 7 Ohio State hosts the Illini at Ohio Stadium seeking to open conference play with a win.

stories.title: Ryan Day previews Illinois matchup as Buckeyes begin Big Ten play
stories.summary: Ohio State coach Ryan Day previewed the Buckeyes' Big Ten opener against Illinois. The Lantern noted Ohio State ranks 10th in the Big Ten in rushing yards per game and converted just one of eight third downs in the 59-3 Kent State win.

stories.title: Red Bull retains Isack Hadjar alongside Max Verstappen for F1 2027
stories.summary: Red Bull confirmed an unchanged 2027 driver lineup, with Isack Hadjar staying alongside Max Verstappen after his debut season at the senior team. Racing Bulls is yet to confirm its own lineup for 2027.

stories.title: F1 build-up to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend begins in Baku
stories.summary: Formula 1's official Wednesday build-up for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix at Baku is underway as teams and drivers arrive for the weekend. Coverage tracks driver schedules, circuit details and weather outlooks ahead of practice.

stories.title: Columbus Crew sack reserve coach Federico Higuaín over 'man's game' remark
stories.summary: The Columbus Crew dismissed reserve-team coach Federico Higuaín after he allegedly grabbed a female referee's hand and told her "don't forget this is a man's game" during an MLS Next Pro match. He had already been given a two-match ban.

stories.title: DeWine declares state of emergency for Ohio counties after flooding
stories.summary: Gov. Mike DeWine declared a state of emergency for five Miami Valley counties — Mercer, Montgomery, Logan, Preble and Greene — following significant recent flooding. The proclamation makes state department resources available to affected communities.

stories.title: Columbus wants to use $500M housing bond to target uneven development
stories.summary: Columbus city officials are pitching a $500 million affordable housing bond to address what they call a "fundamental economic challenge" in the Midwest. The plan aims to counter uneven development and improve housing stability across the city.
